meta.title: Obsidian Mem
meta.description: Turns Obsidian-style Markdown vaults into shared agent memory: vector recall over a locally managed Milvus-Lite database, human-editable memory notes, the memory_read/search/write/dream/audit tools, and lifecycle hooks that inject automatic recall. Vaults are adopted as shared or read-only; with none configured a default vault is created on first memory use.
